title: Government Approves ₹4,687 Crore Interest Subsidies for Ethanol Projects via NABARD
summary: Expanding ethanol production capacity accelerates India's E20 target (20% ethanol blending by 2025-26).

blocks.content: Expanding ethanol production capacity accelerates India's E20 target (20% ethanol blending by 2025-26).

items:
📌 **Core Policy Directives & Scope:**
Union Government approved **₹4,687 crore** in interest subsidies for eligible ethanol projects.
**Nodal Agency:** **NABARD** serves as the nodal disbursing agency (**₹2,075 crore** released since FY23).

💰 **Financial Outlays & Operational Rules:**
**Subvention Terms:** Interest subvention of **6% per annum or 50% of interest charged** (whichever lower) for **5 years**.
Policy Alignment: Boosts grain-based and sugar-based distilleries under Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) program.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: NABARD established July 12, 1982 (B. Sivaraman Committee) | HQ: Mumbai.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Ethanol interest subvention (6% p.a. or 50% of interest for 5 yrs) vs priority sector short-term crop loan subvention (capped at 3%).

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "What role does NABARD play as the nodal agency for ethanol interest subventions?"
💡 **Model Answer: NABARD administers and verifies subvention claims from lending banks to ensure capital credit flows into bio-fuel infrastructure.**
blocks.author: Banking & Regulatory Board Panel
